An experiment you can inspect

What actually learned?

The supervised training fitted a six-class linear readout to activity from this fixed fly circuit. A label-free text encoder turns words into inputs. The fly connections are the published MaleCNS subset used by Oruk, preserved byte-for-byte in the recurrent matrix.

The input pathway and neuron dynamics are mathematical approximations. This is a trained computational model using recorded fly anatomy, not a living brain learning language.

Wordstrain-fitted, label-free encoder→Fly circuit499 fixed recurrent units→Emotiontrained linear readout

Only neuron activity reaches the deployed classifier; there is no direct text shortcut. Uses an English social-media research dataset. Short messages, sarcasm, other languages, and neutral text can be misclassified.
